title: 水认得旧路
note: Archived 19-shot hybrid. Official board is 03-storyboard/shot-list.md + .pipeline/shot_list.json (21 shots / 136s). Do not pad to 6 minutes.
left_right_lock: SC01 modern-channel: sluice lower-left, Sokha mid-left on near bank, river right/deep; fall from left bank into right river. Overrides InkOS 1-03 sluice-on-right. SC02 ancient-shoal: Khmer near bank left, Siamese far bank right; Sokha left, Yunlong at her right; deep channel lower left, current to left; camera stays on Khmer bank. SC03 granary: pillar left, waterline at foot, guards enter from right, torches beyond doorway right-deep.

continuity_bible.left_right: Modern: Sokha to sluice. Ancient: Sokha left, Yunlong right, Siamese opposite. Granary: pillar left, waterline at feet, guard right.
continuity_bible.eyeline: SC01 sluice and water. SC02 Sokha fire then shoal; Yunlong her then far bank. SC03 Sokha waterline at pillar foot.
continuity_bible.wardrobe: Sokha modern survey clothes dry SH001-002, soaked from SH003 to end, no ancient costume change. Yunlong Khmer patrol armor. Guard night post.
continuity_bible.day_night: SC01 day to storm. SC02 dusk. SC03 night. Hard cut SH015 dusk underwater to SH016 night reeds.
continuity_bible.props: Survey pole SH001-SH003 only, gone after fall. Wrist rope from SH008; may slacken in water. Granary snare at SH017, bound to pillar SH018.

dropped_from_pipeline_8: Packing six actions into one 7s master
14s static OTC holding four lines plus arrow plus drag
Pan-follow across the sunken-log time jump
50mm close that must also show distant torches dying
